FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business'

WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g
  ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

       p.SEX,
       p.Birthday
FROM   Patient     AS p
JOIN   Laboratory  AS l
       ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE  l.LDH >= 500

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE 
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM atom a2 
                WHERE a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id 
                  AND a2.element = 'f'
            ) THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
         END) * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_no_f
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT l.name
FROM League AS l
JOIN Match AS m ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM Match
        WHERE season = '2008/2009'
        GROUP BY league_id
    )
)

SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS rank,
    s.superhero_name,
    s.height_cm
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC

SELECT
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Date LIKE '2012-08%' THEN t.Amount * t.Price END) AS august_2012_spent
FROM transactions_1k AS t
WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508

SELECT u.DisplayName,
       SUM(p.ViewCount) AS total_popularity
FROM   users u
JOIN   posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE  u.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY u.DisplayName
ORDER BY total_popularity DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.Tags
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p.CommentCount = 0
  AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute AS a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute AS ha2
      JOIN attribute AS a2 ON ha2.attribute_id = a2.id
      WHERE LOWER(a2.attribute_name) = 'strength'
  )

SELECT AVG(L.ALB) AS avg_alb
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.PLT > 400

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN total_all = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (total_a * 100.0) / total_all
    END AS fully_paid_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_a,
        SUM(amount) AS total_all
    FROM loan
) AS sums

SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) 
       FROM trans 
      WHERE account_id = 3 
        AND operation = 'VYDAJ') AS statement_requests,
    (SELECT k_symbol
       FROM trans
      WHERE account_id = 3
      GROUP BY k_symbol

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5 AND l.WBC < 9.0

SELECT fd.flavorText
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON c.uuid = fd.uuid

FROM   cards     AS c
JOIN   legalities AS l
       ON l.uuid = c.uuid

FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 2008

  )

FROM cards AS c

FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'

FROM event AS e

GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name

FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch

WHERE sch.District = 'Fresno Unified'

LIMIT 1

FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Gold'

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp      ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp      ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN gender g           ON g.id = s.gender_id

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

FROM sets s
JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE s.block = 'Commander'

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p."First Date" > DATE('1990-01-01')

FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

FROM member AS mem
JOIN major AS mjr
  ON mem.link_to_major = mjr.major_id
WHERE mem.phone = '809-555-3360'

SELECT
    e.event_name
FROM
    event AS e
JOIN
    budget AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE
    e.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name
HAVING
    SUM(b.amount) > 0
ORDER BY
    (SUM(b.spent) * 1.0) / SUM(b.amount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN sum1996 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (sum1997 - sum1996) * 100.0 / sum1996
    END AS growth_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996' THEN l.amount END) AS sum1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' THEN l.amount END) AS sum1997
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a      ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp d         ON d.account_id = a.account_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client c       ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
) AS totals

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date >= '201308'
  AND Date <= '201311'

SELECT 
    ( (max853 - max854) * 100.0 / max854 ) AS percent_faster
FROM (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT MAX(CAST(fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) FROM results WHERE raceId = 853) AS max853,
        (SELECT MAX(CAST(fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) FROM results WHERE raceId = 854) AS max854
) AS speeds
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE d.forename = 'Paul'
      AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
      AND r.raceId = 853
)

FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19

FROM superhero AS s

FROM races AS r

FROM Patient p

FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0

FROM yearmonth AS ym

FROM Player_Attributes pa

WITH avg_fin AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, AVG(finishing) AS avg_fin
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
tallest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
shortest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
tall_fin AS (
    SELECT avg_fin
    FROM avg_fin
    JOIN tallest USING (player_api_id)
),
short_fin AS (
    SELECT avg_fin
    FROM avg_fin
    JOIN shortest USING (player_api_id)
)
SELECT CASE
           WHEN (SELECT avg_fin FROM tall_fin) >= (SELECT avg_fin FROM short_fin)
                THEN 'highest'
           ELSE 'shortest'
       END AS answer

WITH cons AS (
    SELECT
        ym.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID, c.Segment

        p.ID,
        p.Birthday,
        p."First Date"
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'          -- allow for combined diagnoses
      AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
, oldest_sjs AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        Birthday,
        "First Date"
    FROM sjs_patients
    ORDER BY Birthday ASC                    -- earliest birthday = oldest
    LIMIT 1
)
, last_lab AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        MAX(l."Date") AS last_lab_date
    FROM Laboratory l
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT
    ll.last_lab_date,
    CASE
        WHEN o."First Date" IS NOT NULL
        THEN CAST(strftime('%Y', o."First Date") AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', o.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
             - (strftime('%m%d', o."First Date") < strftime('%m%d', o.Birthday))
        ELSE NULL
    END AS age_at_initial_arrival
FROM oldest_sjs o
JOIN last_lab ll ON ll.ID = o.ID

        MIN(total_cons) AS min_cons
    FROM cust_cons

     AND c.total_cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)

/* 1️⃣  Identify the customer who had a transaction on 2012‑08‑25 whose total amount paid is 634.8.
   The total paid can be either stored directly in Price (if Amount = 1) or as Amount*Price.
   A small tolerance is used to avoid floating‑point mismatches. */
WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
      AND (
            ABS(Price - 634.8) < 0.001                     -- price already equals the total
         OR ABS(Amount * Price - 634.8) < 0.001            -- computed total equals the target
          )
    LIMIT 1
),

/* 2️⃣  Sum the consumption for that customer for the whole year 2012. */
cons_2012 AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption_2012
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2012%'               -- e.g. '201201', '201212', …
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),

/* 3️⃣  Sum the consumption for the same customer for the whole year 2013. */
cons_2013 AS (
    SELECT CustomerID,
           SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE Date LIKE '2013%'               -- e.g. '201301', '201312', …
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)

/* 4️⃣  Compute the consumption decrease rate:
        (cons_2012 - cons_2013) / cons_2012   */
SELECT 
    (c12.total_consumption_2012 - c13.total_consumption_2013) * 1.0
    / c12.total_consumption_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM target_customer tc
JOIN cons_2012  c12 ON c12.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID
JOIN cons_2013  c13 ON c13.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID

WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel'
  AND (subtypes IS NULL OR subtypes <> 'Angel')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT DISTINCT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE (IFNULL("Enrollment (K-12)", 0) + IFNULL("Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)) > 500

SELECT 
    c.Text,
    u.DisplayName
FROM comments AS c
JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON c.UserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Analysing wind data with R'
ORDER BY c.CreationDate DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT fd.language
FROM sets AS s
JOIN cards AS c
     ON instr(',' || c.printings || ',', ',' || s.code || ',') > 0   -- the card was printed in this set
JOIN foreign_data AS fd
     ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.code = 'ARC'                -- set code for Archenemy
  AND s.mcmName = 'Archenemy'       -- Magic Card Market name
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND fd.language <> ''

WITH customers_on_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS eur_percentage
FROM customers_on_date cd
JOIN customers c
  ON c.CustomerID = cd.CustomerID

SELECT ph.Comment
FROM postHistory AS ph
JOIN posts AS p ON ph.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
  AND ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT type
FROM event
WHERE location = 'MU 215'

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

SELECT maj.major_name
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS maj
  ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Brent'
  AND m.last_name = 'Thomason'

SELECT q.q1
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Bruno'
  AND d.surname = 'Senna'
  AND q.raceId = 354

SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN id = 6 THEN jumping END) -
    MAX(CASE WHEN id = 23 THEN jumping END) AS jumping_score_difference
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE id IN (6, 23)

SELECT DISTINCT b.category
FROM event AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0

SELECT 
    (cnt_2010 * 100.0 / total) - (cnt_2011 * 100.0 / total) AS percentage_difference
FROM (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) AS total,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2010,
        SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Date) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt_2011
    FROM badges
    WHERE Name = 'Student'
)

SELECT
    source,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM income
WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN c.uuid END) /
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS french_percentage
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
       ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.isStorySpotlight = 1

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    COALESCE(s.School, f."School Name") AS school_name,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_count,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment,
    (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS frpm_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT
    e.ID,
    (CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
     - (strftime('%m-%d','now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) AS age
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+'

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' AND c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS blue_female_percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender   AS g ON s.gender_id   = g.id
JOIN colour   AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS netherlandic_youngest_count
FROM (
    SELECT nationality
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS youngest
WHERE nationality IN ('Netherlands', 'Dutch')
